Name: Fowl Play
Author: tbonehunter
Description: When starting a new farm type (other than Meadowlands, which already starts with a coop and 2 chickens), you will receive a "Coop Placement Stake" and 15 hay in the starter package along with your standard 15 parsnips. You will need to find or clear a 6 wide by 3 high area clear of obstruction for coop placement, and place the stake in the left top corner of that 6x3 area. You will receive a success message if the area is suitable, a message to find another location if there is obstruction. The next morning, the coop and two chickens will be located at the stake placement. If you are starting a Meadowlands farm, you will get the 15 parsnips that other farms receive as their starter package.

Downloads.Description: Start any farm map (unless modded to preclude this) with a coop and two chickens, like in the Meadowlands farm. Place the coop stake, the coop and chickens will arrive overnight.
